field_epsr.denominator: topology-eligible deployments on which vector was attempted
field_epsr.note: Synthetic cases are not deployments and MUST NOT be counted as field EPSR.
field_epsr.numerator: topology-eligible deployments with >=1 satisfied frozen evidence path

topology_binding.rule: external_evidence.source_domain must equal frozen topology.relationship.evidence_origin; acceptance_policy.acting_domain must equal frozen topology.relationship.acting_system

topology_requirement.source: frozen deployment topology declaration, never inferred from telemetry absence
